The '''ancient city''' established by the [[Je'daii Order]] to support [[Vur Tepe]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. It was in ruins by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The city was built just north of the mouth of the [[Tythos River]] and northwest of the Je'daii temple-city [[Kaleth]]. During the [[Flesh Raider uprising]], the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of Tython occupied the ruins while forming an army under [[Grand Chieftain]] [[Keshk]] and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]].
